threads.body: [General] This new definition drops `messaging.destination.subscription.name`, although consumer operations still record it: `MessagingMetricsAdvice` includes the key in the client-operation duration advice, and `MessagingConsumerMetrics` records the merged operation attributes. `MetaDataCollector.java:197-209` only inspects the first metric point, so choosing a producer point under-reports the valid consumer attributes here. Preserve the subscription attribute and update collection to union attributes across points before regenerating the definition ID and reference.
